title: Project skills
subtitle: SKILL.md folders that live in the repository, committed with the code and shared by the team. The folder they sit in decides which CLIs can see them.
workspaceSubtitle: Skills owned by this workspace and available to every project in it. Stored in the CC-Panes data directory and mounted per session (natively for Claude / Codex, injected into the prompt for other CLIs) — nothing is written to any repo or CLI home.
